name: Balsamic vinegar
description: Grape must aged in wood for years into a sweet dark syrup.

tcm.note: Read with vinegar, which is warm and blood-moving.

ayurveda.note: Sour, sweet and long-fermented — firmly ushna.

histamine.note: Years of barrel ageing on a grape base — vinegar and wine problems compounded.

effects.note: Acetic acid taken with a meal measurably blunts the blood glucose spike that follows — a meta-analysis of eleven trials found a real, if inconsistent, reduction in post-meal glucose and insulin response, with notable heterogeneity between studies. A generous drizzle delivers about what the trials used, though this vinegar's own added sugar works somewhat against the same curve it's blunting. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
